name: yalesites-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for the Yale ITS Digital Experiences team

plugins.name: yalesites
plugins.description: Deep expertise on the YaleSites Drupal platform: Layout Builder, blocks, Views, content types, menus, taxonomy, accessibility, editorial workflow, and training resources. Includes the yalesites-portfolio skill with measured block adoption, config trends, exemplar sites and page patterns from a crawl of the live portfolio (known gaps: Gallery unreviewed, 5 sites without data).

plugins.name: yalesites-ticket
plugins.description: Report YaleSites bugs and requests as well-formed GitHub issues, and groom or scope tickets, features, and epics. Includes guided first-time setup (onboard), screenshots on YaleSites-Internal tickets, and UX research context. Works on its own.

plugins.name: yalesites-review
plugins.description: PR review for YaleSites: walk through what to test, run it on the multidev or Storybook, and post the review. Also scopes reviews to what each reviewer rules on and keeps tickets in sync with how the work turned out. Assumes yalesites-ticket is installed.

plugins.name: yalesites-dev
plugins.description: Day-to-day Git, pull-request, GitHub-issue, and Drupal development skills for YaleSites developers — look up/plan issues, conventional commits, cross-repo branch management, PR description and creation, Drupal coding conventions, and running PHPUnit tests in the YaleSites Lando environment.

plugins.name: yalesites-migration
plugins.description: Read-only migration assessment of a source site (Drupal 7 included) against the YaleSites content model: content type and component mapping, what will not carry over, effort, and mechanism options.

plugins.name: yalesites-beacon
plugins.description: Beacon AI chatbot testing for YaleSites: quick per-site question sets, full tiered test banks, and analysis of AI Tester A/B comparison exports.

plugins.name: yalesites-security
plugins.description: Security tooling for YaleSites projects — currently supply-chain auditing (malicious-package detection via live OSV.dev and GitHub malware advisories), distinct from ordinary CVE scanning.
